label: N-50
map_notes: Parcel 50 is not a single flat 3-storey block. The Pervititch crop shows a small rectangular right/rear open void and a height/roof change. The front/north street piece reads as the lower 2-unit flat-roofed part, while the rear/dashed map area reads as the taller 3-unit roofed part. Model it as one L-plan building group with two touching volumes and different roofs, not as a separate grey box.

zones.description: Lower north/front masonry mass for the numbered 50 entrance; front reads flatter on the map.
Taller south/rear wing wrapping the rectangular open lightwell; dashed rear map area reads as the roofed 3-unit part.

open_questions: The exact handwritten height abbreviation on N-50 remains soft in the raster, but the latest map reread/user correction sets the front/north part as 2-unit flat and the rear/dashed part as 3-unit roofed.

resolved_assumptions.l_plan: The right/rear rectangular lightwell is cut from the N-50 mass, so the visible footprint reads as an L plan.
resolved_assumptions.height_step: User/map reread takes priority over the old single 3-storey interpretation: model the front/north piece as lower and flatter, and the rear/dashed wing as the taller roofed part.
resolved_assumptions.not_extra_building: The lightwell is open space, not a detached grey building.
